# Emanuele Pane and James Shannon
Date: 2026-09-23 | Duration: 64.27999877929688m

## Summary
The team wants to overcome a current limit of 80 experiments per year, caused by technical limitations and operational fragility, while improving trust, learning, and growth. The goal is to enable squads and product managers to create and interpret experiments independently, shifting the CRO team toward strategic guidance. GrowthBook was presented as a warehouse-native platform that connects with Snowflake, supports reusable metrics, feature flags, sticky bucketing, namespaces, holdouts, 27 SDK variants, and AI-assisted Bayesian and frequentist analysis. Data integration could reuse existing Telium and Adobe Analytics pipelines through custom middleware or use GrowthBook’s managed event forwarder, with the latter involving an infrastructure fee. The three-month pilot will run during peak season, assess technical and organizational fit, improve metric and Adobe Analytics data alignment, and define resources, data flows, costs, and operating-model changes. Current benchmarks show about 25% of experiments produce an RPV lift, while the aspiration is to increase experiment volume by 50% without reducing quality.

## Keywords
experimentation, data integration, A/B testing, Growth Book, Snowflake, pilot program
